abstract: The DVB Projecti DVB originally stood for Digital Video Broadcasting., which celebrates its 30th anniversary in 2023, is an industry-led consortium of the world’s leading media and technology companies working together to design open technical specifications for digital media delivery. DVB’s work is today focused primarily on Internet Protocol (IP)-based technologies.
